claim_boundary.not_supported: True run recovery, candidate-world coverage, population prevalence, city-scale certification, or proof of novelty relative to prior work.
claim_boundary.supported: Conditional effects of restricting event families on one fixed small public exact-time input.

extraction.selection: Existing count-reconciled NYC smoke extraction, first 4 core rows in source order, then nearest 12 buffers by exact temporal gap and source tie order; buffers require nonmissing miles and seconds. Selection uses outcome availability but not outcome magnitude. Remaining original cores may become optional buffers, as in the existing reduced audit.
extraction.source_identity_rule: New extraction; do not assert byte identity with the old scale instance. Store snapshot, query and input hashes. Fail on metadata/count change or unexpected provider.

families.clique: Every pair of members overlaps by at least epsilon, satisfying the same ordered-event constraints.
families.ordered: Connected interval-overlap graph and simultaneous occupancy at most C; total event size may exceed C.
families.pair: Exactly two members, satisfying the same ordered-event constraints; K=2 is not the same restriction as C=2.

design.outcome_comparison: For each capacity evaluate every positive integer q feasible in all three families. Keep the same q and query coefficients across families. Do not compare outcomes at model-specific maximum support.
design.publication: Commit aggregate tables, source/code hashes and witness hashes only. Keep raw input and event witnesses in ignored local scratch; never upload them.
design.purpose: Retrospective fixed-input diagnostic of event-family restrictions, not a truth or population study.
design.scope_limit: Only 4+12 in this protocol. Assess all results, including equality, before declaring larger diagnostics. No threshold search, truth-coverage claim or population extrapolation.
design.support_comparison: Report the entire reachable selected-buffer-count set, including zero, for each family and capacity. Record ordered-only counts as exclusions by the restricted model.
design.verification: Complete run-column enumeration and exact finite master; independently formulate a binary column-selection MILP for every q and endpoint, replay its chosen events and compare with enumeration. Decimal query coefficients are scored with rational arithmetic. A MILP timeout is an unresolved verification, never infeasibility.
design.world_constraints: Each core exactly once; each buffer at most once; every event has at least two members and touches a core; no buffer-only events.
